description: Turn messy place names into standard names and codes: countries (ISO 3166 codes), the states/provinces/regions of one country (ISO 3166-2 codes) or US counties (FIPS codes). Understands other languages, abbreviations and typos ("Bayern", "BY", "Bavarai" → Bavaria, DE-BY). Use it to clean a column of locations before a map, a join or a report. Draws nothing; returns one line per name: the standard name and code, the options when ambiguous, or 'not found' with a suggestion.

country.description: For regions: the country, e.g. 'DE' or 'Germany'.

names.description: The place names to clean, as written in the data.

state.description: For US counties: limit to one state, e.g. 'TX'.

name: match_places
title: Clean up place names
